get_latest_observation.description: Get a station's latest readings: wind speed, direction and gusts, wave height, period and direction, air pressure, air and sea temperature, in metric and US units, with how many minutes old they are and a one-line summary. Buoys measure waves every 30 or 60 minutes, so the waves carry their own time.

description: Read live marine weather from NOAA's National Data Buoy Center: the wind, waves, air pressure and air and sea temperature reported by about 1,300 buoys, coastal stations and offshore platforms run by NOAA and its partners, most of them around the US. Find stations by name or around a place, get a station's latest readings or up to 45 days of them, read a buoy's swell and wind waves, and get the newest readings of every station near a point. Start a workflow when a reading, such as wave height or wind speed, crosses a threshold. No account or API key required.

noaa_ndbc_reading_crosses_threshold_trig.description: Runs when a buoy or coastal station's reading, such as wave height or wind speed, rises above or falls below a threshold, once per crossing
noaa_ndbc_reading_crosses_threshold_trig.display_name: NOAA Buoy Reading Crosses a Threshold

parameters.description: The station to watch, picked from the list or typed as its ID, such as 46026 (off San Francisco).
parameters.name: station

parameters.description: What to watch, in the unit the threshold is in: wave height (feet or metres), dominant wave period (seconds), wind speed or gust (knots or m/s), water or air temperature (°F or °C) or air pressure (hPa).
parameters.name: measurement

parameters.description: Whether to run when the reading rises above the threshold or falls below it.
parameters.name: direction

parameters.description: The number the reading must cross, in the measurement's unit, such as 10 for waves over 10 feet.
parameters.name: threshold
